description:
Market, governance and risk data in one tool. Pick a kind:

    liquidity_depth (entity=coin id), yield_data (entity=protocol, optional),
    governance_activity (entity=protocol slug; window=days, 90),
    bridge_flows (entity=bridge id, optional), exchange_health (entity=exchange id, optional),
    volatility (entity=asset id), incidents (entity=entity id, optional),
    peg_monitor (summary of latest deviation + status per coin; detail=true with entity
    returns that coin's 5-minute series, window=hours, 24),
    venue_shift (entity=operator slug, optional), asset_footprint (entity=token or symbol),
    divergence (capital-flow vs quality signals; severity=notable|alert|critical, limit=20, window=hours 24),
    treasury_events (entity=wallet, optional), riskiest_wallets (limit=20),
    scoring_backlog (limit=20).

    Responses are capped near 12 KB; an unknown kind returns the list of kinds.
name: basis_data
